name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand tall.

name: Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are at 90°.
Push through the front heel to return. Alternate sides.

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is a straight line.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, one foot flat, the other leg straight and lifted.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips until your body is in a line.
Keep your hips level, pause, then lower slowly. Switch legs after the set.

name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart. Hold a wall for balance if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower slowly.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep knees over ankles and press your back into the wall.
Hold, breathing steadily.

name: Jump Squat
steps: Lower into a squat with chest up.
Explode upward, leaving the ground.
Land softly back into the next squat.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Rest your back foot on a chair or bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive up through the front heel. Complete all reps, then switch legs.

name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest.
Squat deep, keeping elbows inside your knees.
Stand up tall, squeezing your glutes.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees.
Push your hips back, sliding the weights down your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then squeeze glutes to stand.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are at 90°.
Push off the back foot into the next step.

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit with your back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the sled until knees reach about 90°.
Press away without locking your knees.

name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Set the bar on your upper back, brace your core.
Sit down and back until thighs are parallel or lower.
Drive up, keeping your chest tall.

name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, grip just outside your legs.
Brace, keep your back flat and push the floor away.
Lock out with hips and knees together, then lower under control.

name: Wall Push-Up
steps: Place hands on a wall at chest height, slightly wider than shoulders.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Press back to the start.

name: Knee Push-Up
steps: Start on hands and knees, body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows about 45° from your body.
Press back up.

name: Push-Up
steps: Hands under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Press back up without sagging your hips.

name: Decline Push-Up
steps: Place your feet on a chair or bench, hands on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor, core tight.
Press up powerfully.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a bench (or the floor) holding dumbbells over your chest.
Lower until elbows are just below the bench line.
Press up and slightly inward.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set a bench to about 30°–45° and lie back with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the weights up until arms are straight.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie back with dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms wide with a slight elbow bend until you feel a stretch.
Squeeze the weights back together.

name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the seat so handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly, keeping shoulders back.

name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar, feet planted.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with control.
Press it back up over your shoulders.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Hold a moment, then lower.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
steps: Lie face down with arms by your sides, lifting chest slightly.
Sweep your arms in an arc overhead and back to your sides.
Keep your neck long.

name: Table Inverted Row
steps: Lie under a sturdy table and grip its edge.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest to the table.
Lower slowly.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one hand and knee on a bench or chair, dumbbell in the other hand.
Pull the weight toward your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower with control, then switch sides.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
steps: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, dumbbells hanging.
Row both weights to your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower.

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Grip the bar wider than shoulders and sit with thighs secured.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving elbows down.
Return slowly to full stretch.

name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit tall with a slight knee bend, gripping the handle.
Pull to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend arms slowly.

name: Barbell Row
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, bar hanging at knee height.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower under control.

name: Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, shoulders active.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower to a full hang.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
steps: Start in a high plank, feet wide for balance.
Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides.

name: Pike Push-Up
steps: From a downward-dog position, hips high.
Bend elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up.

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
steps: Place your feet on a chair with hips high.
Lower your head between your hands.
Press up strongly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, core braced.
Press overhead until arms are straight.
Lower to your shoulders.

name: Lateral Raise
steps: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise arms out to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend.
Lower slowly.

name: Arnold Press
steps: Start with dumbbells in front of your chest, palms facing you.
Rotate your palms outward as you press overhead.
Reverse the motion to return.

name: Cable Face Pull
steps: Set a rope at face height and pull it toward your forehead.
Flare elbows high and squeeze your rear delts.
Return with control.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Hold the bar at your collarbone, glutes and core tight.
Press it overhead, moving your head through at the top.
Lower back to your collarbone.

name: Chair Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair, hands beside your hips.
Slide forward and lower your body by bending your elbows to 90°.
Press back up.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Place your hands under your chest, elbows tucked.
Lower down keeping elbows close to your ribs.
Press back up.

name: Diamond Push-Up
steps: Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers under your chest.
Lower your chest to your hands.
Press up.

name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl to your shoulders without swinging.
Lower slowly.

name: Hammer Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up keeping your elbows pinned.
Lower with control.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Extend back up.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
steps: Grip the bar at chest height, elbows at your sides.
Push down until arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
steps: Hold the bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width.
Curl to your chest without leaning back.
Lower under control.

name: Plank
steps: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Make a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze abs and glutes, breathe steadily.

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping your back flat.
Return and switch sides.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie with knees bent, hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders off the floor using your abs.
Lower slowly.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie back with hands by your head, legs lifted.
Bring one elbow to the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Alternate in a pedalling motion.

name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs straight, hands under your hips.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lower without letting your back arch.

name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit leaning back with feet slightly raised.
Rotate your torso side to side, touching the floor by your hips.
Keep your chest lifted.

name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on one side, forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie on your back, press your lower back into the floor.
Lift shoulders and straight legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shallow banana shape.

name: V-Up
steps: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your legs and torso to meet in a V.
Lower with control.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Start with feet together, arms at your sides.
Jump feet wide while raising arms overhead.
Jump back and repeat at a steady pace.

name: High Knees
steps: Run in place, driving knees to hip height.
Pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.

name: Shadow Boxing
steps: Stand in a staggered stance, hands up.
Throw jabs, crosses and hooks with light bounce.
Keep moving.

name: Burpee
steps: Squat, place hands down and jump feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up (optional), jump feet forward.
Explode upward with a jump.

name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive your knees toward your chest alternately, fast.
Keep hips level.

name: Skater Hops
steps: Leap sideways from one foot to the other.
Land softly, sweeping the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms for balance.

name: Inchworm
steps: Stand tall, then fold forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a plank.
Walk your hands back and stand up.

name: Bear Crawl
steps: On hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor.
Crawl forward using opposite hand and foot.
Keep your back flat.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
steps: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and squat deep.
Drive up and press the weights overhead in one motion.
Lower to your shoulders and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Man Maker
steps: From a plank on dumbbells, do a push-up and a row on each side.
Jump your feet in, stand and press overhead.
Lower and return to plank.

name: Cat-Cow
steps: On hands and knees, arch your back and look up.
Round your spine and tuck your chin.
Flow with your breath.

name: Child's Pose
steps: Sit back on your heels with arms stretched forward.
Rest your forehead down.
Breathe deeply.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and shift your weight forward.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit with one leg extended, the other bent.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Thoracic Rotation
steps: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the ceiling.
Alternate sides.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step into a deep lunge with both hands inside your front foot.
Rotate your chest and reach one arm up.
Switch sides.

name: Cobra Stretch
steps: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, opening your chest while hips stay down.
Hold and breathe.

name: Arm Circles
steps: Extend arms out to the sides.
Make slow controlled circles, then reverse.
Keep shoulders relaxed.
